prose.subject: URGENT: Vendor Payout Account Update - INV-36455
prose.body:
Hi Hana,

Please see the updated payout instructions for our upcoming settlement. Due to a backend migration on our finance portal, our NEAR payout account has been temporarily changed to ensure faster clearing times. This affects all pending invoices, including INV-36455.

To avoid a processing delay that could impact our quarterly reconciliation, please release the payment of 6969.30 USDC to the new account below:

ps-finance.testnet

I know this is short notice, but our systems team confirmed the old account will be deprecated by end of day. If you can approve this via your standard payment flow, it will go through instantly. I have attached the updated vendor profile for your records.

Let me know if you need any further details or if your finance team has questions. I am available on the line below if you need to verify this change directly.

Best regards,

Priya Adeyemi
Senior Finance Coordinator
Pembury Security
pembury-security.example
